system_prompt_style.evidence_quote: These pieces of information are organized into a prompt template and input into the model to generate a set of sub-problems.
system_prompt_style.note: Paper-only; per-tool prompt templates, no system-prompt mechanism shown.

env_context_strategy.evidence_quote: First, it compares the question embedding to the schema embeddings𝐸𝑠 to identify the most relevant tables from the database.
env_context_strategy.note: Combined with Text-to-SQL retrieval; closest value embedding_rag (could be mixed).

context_compaction.note: Paper only; no config or loop available to check compaction.

observation_format.note: SQL results and retrieved cells passed into text prompts.

tool_call_format.note: Paper-only; LangChain mentioned but no parser described.

tool_count.note: Paper lists four tool categories (decomposition, retrieval, SQL rewrite, report generation) but no tool schemas; repo not in evidence.

edit_primitive.evidence_quote: The tool module can be generally divided into four categories, including problem decomposition tools, tabular retrieval tools, SQL rewrite tools, and answer generation tools.
edit_primitive.note: Tool list stated in paper contains no file-editing tool.

tool_schema_source.note: No tool schema source in evidence.

protocol_standardization.note: No source/dependencies to grep; paper only.

loop_primitives.evidence_quote: If the question is complex, the Planning module invokes the decomposition tools from tools module, breaking it down into sub-questions.
loop_primitives.note: Decompose -> retrieve -> SQL rewrite -> report stages with conditional skips; described as dynamic planning.

planning_granularity.evidence_quote: Each user question is associated with an execution path generated by the planning module, which includes key strategies such as whether the problem needs decomposition, which tools to use, etc.
planning_granularity.note: Sub-question set and stored planning paths.

multi_agent_topology.evidence_quote:
we propose DAgent, an LLM-based agent system specifi-
cally designed to generate analytical reports

delegation_mechanism.note: Paper does not discuss delegation; no code.

short_term_state.evidence_quote: The intermediate data and results generated at each step are recorded in the Memory.

long_term_memory.evidence_quote: the system stores the user's question and its execution results in memory.
long_term_memory.note: Historical questions/results and planning paths reused for similar questions.

self_verification.note: SQL rewrite evaluates queries but no verification mechanism documented; no code.

termination_condition.note: Pipeline ends after report generation per paper; no loop code.

cost_controls.note: Paper mentions choosing Text-to-SQL model by resources (possible model_routing) but no mechanism code.

eval_hooks.note: Paper describes DA-Dataset and LLM-based metrics, but whether an eval runner ships in the repo is not in evidence.

target_domain.evidence_quote:
an LLM agent system for RDB-DA re-
port generation tasks, dubbed DAgent
target_domain.note: Relational database data analysis report generation.

open_source.note: Paper says code available at github.com/ZJU-LLMs/DAgent, but no LICENSE file in evidence; CC BY-NC-ND refers to the paper.

model_agnostic.evidence_quote: By leveraging advanced language models, such as LLaMA or ChatGPT
model_agnostic.note: Uses LLaMA2-13B LoRA, GPT-4, DeepSeek v2.5 via LangChain.

primary_artifact.evidence_quote:
The source code, data, and/or other artifacts have been made available at
https://github.com/ZJU-LLMs/DAgent.
primary_artifact.note: Only the paper was in the evidence bundle; repo not pinned.

first_release_date.note: No tag/commit data; paper arXiv 2503.13269 (v2 2025-04-01), v1 date not in evidence.
